import json,sys
p=json.load(sys.stdin)
g={'__name__':'audit_module'}
exec(compile(p['code'],'audit.py','exec'),g)
pg={'__name__':'script_policy'}
exec(compile(p['policy'],'policy.py','exec'),pg)
r=g['analyze'](p['files'],pg,p['review'])
sg={'__name__':'ssh_policy'}
exec(compile(p['ssh_policy'],'ssh_policy.py','exec'),sg)
r['ssh_audit']=sg['analyze'](p['files'])
r['ssh_audit']['manual_review']=p['ssh_review']
import hashlib
r['ssh_audit']['review_source_unchanged']=all(k in p['files'] and hashlib.sha256(p['files'][k].encode()).hexdigest()==v for k,v in p['ssh_review']['source_binding'].items())
ig={'__name__':'interpreter_policy'}
exec(compile(p['interpreter_policy'],'interpreter_policy.py','exec'),ig)
r['interpreter_audit']=ig['analyze'](p['files'])
r['blockingFindings']+=r['interpreter_audit']['blockingFindings']
r['blockingFindings']+=r['ssh_audit']['blockingFindings']
if r['blockingFindings']:r['status']='failed'
print(json.dumps(r))
sys.exit(bool(r['errors'] or r['blockingFindings']))
